series.name: Official Electrolux UK portable AC per-code articles
series.notes: Official Electrolux UK support articles: P1 full tray, L3 condenser DC fan, E7 indoor motor, E4 display↔main PCB. Portable meanings differ from split P1/L3/E4 — never merge with IE split file. Not PK retail split line.

title.ur: Neeche ka tray ya water tank bhara hua

meaning.en: Condensate collection tray is full; unit locks out until drained.
meaning.ur: Condensate tray poori bhar gayi hai; khaali kiye baghair unit band rehti hai.

causes.en: High humidity continuous cooling producing lots of condensate.
causes.ur: Zyada humidity mein continuous cooling se condensate bari miqdar mein banta hai.

causes.en: Drain plug left fitted / pump not used in continuous-drain setup.
causes.ur: Drain plug lga hua rehna ya continuous drain setup mein pump istemal na hona.

solutions.en: Move the unit to a drain location, remove the bottom drain plug, and let water drain away.
solutions.ur: Unit ko drain ki jagah le jayein, neeche ka drain plug nikaalein aur paani ko nikalne dein.

solutions.en: Restart until the P1 symbol clears; if it repeats, contact Authorized Service Center.
solutions.ur: P1 symbol khatam hone tak dobara on karein; agar baar baar aaye to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

source.title: Electrolux UK — Portable AC displays code P1 (PI)

notes.en: Corroborated by portable UM snippet (manua.ls ECU7677CSW): P1 = water tank full. Collision with split P1 (test mode).
notes.ur: Portable UM snippet (manua.ls ECU7677CSW) se saboot mila: P1 = water tank full. Split P1 (test mode) se is ka collision hai.

title.ur: Condenser DC fan motor kharab ho jana

meaning.en: Portable unit's condenser fan motor has failed.
meaning.ur: Portable unit ka condenser fan motor kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Fan motor seized or winding open.
causes.ur: Fan motor jam ya winding khuli.
Vibration ke baad connector dhila ho gaya.

solutions.ur: Authorised Service Center se rabta karein (official hal).

solutions.en: Do not keep running — overheating risk to the condenser.
solutions.ur: Chalate na rahein — condenser ke overheating ka risk hai.

source.title: Electrolux UK — Portable AC displays code L3

notes.en: Split IE L3 wording is broader (outdoor DC fan malfunction).
notes.ur: Split IE L3 ka wording zyada broad hai (outdoor DC fan kharab).

meaning.en: Portable unit's indoor (room-side) fan motor has failed.
meaning.ur: Portable unit ka indoor (room side) fan motor kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Indoor fan motor open winding or jam.
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor ki winding khuli ya motor jam.
Blower wheel mein resh aur mail jama ho jana.

solutions.ur: Authorised Service Center se rabta karein (official hal).

solutions.en: Power off and inspect airflow path before the visit.
solutions.ur: Visit se pehle power off karke hawa ka rasta dekh lein.

source.title: Electrolux UK — Portable AC displays code E7

notes.en: E7 not present on the IE split table.
notes.ur: E7 IE split table mein maujood nahi hai.

title.en: Display PCB ↔ main control PCB communication fault
title.ur: Display PCB aur main control PCB ke darmiyan communication ki kharabi

meaning.en: Front display board cannot talk to the main controller in the portable unit.
meaning.ur: Portable unit mein front display board main controller se baat nahi kar pa raha.

causes.en: Ribbon cable between display and main board not seated.
causes.ur: Display aur main board ke darmiyan ribbon cable theek se baithi hui nahi.

causes.en: Display board or main board connector damage.
causes.ur: Display board ya main board ka connector kharab.

solutions.ur: Authorised Service Center se rabta karein (official hal).

solutions.en: Power-cycle once; if E4 remains, service is required.
solutions.ur: Aik baar power cycle karein; E4 phir bhi rahe to service zaroori hai.

source.title: Electrolux UK — Portable AC displays code E4

notes.en: Collision: split IE E4 = compressor discharge high-temp protection — different meaning, same code string. Always scope by product type.
notes.ur: Collision: split IE E4 = compressor discharge high-temp protection — matlab alag hai, code string wahi hai. Hamesha product type ke mutabiq farq karein.
